title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases Worksheet: First Extension Days
content:
**Definitions.** For the first extension of a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case on a Cedarline Summit loan whose borrower has died:

- **Measured extension:** the calendar days from the current resolution deadline to the end the request's supporting document sets. It is counted below zero when that end falls before the current resolution deadline.
- **Extension length:** the measured extension with every addition made and every deduction taken.
- **First extension days:** the extension length raised to 30 calendar days when it is fewer, so that no extension shorter than 30 days is granted, and then limited to the plan's extension days when it is more. Every addition and deduction is made before the extension length is raised or limited. The result is a whole number of calendar days.

**Standard values.** The measured extension runs from the current resolution deadline to 180 calendar days after the date on the extension request's supporting document, the end of a standard six-month marketing term. Nothing is added to or taken off the extension length.

**The request the grant rests on.** This is the most recently received extension request on the case that is still awaiting a decision. Among extension requests received on the same day, the more recently received is the one recorded later by its recorded date and time.

**When the figure is zero.**

- Where no extension request on the case is awaiting a decision, no extension is granted and the first extension days are zero.
- Where the supporting document of that request is neither a financing commitment nor a listing agreement, or carries no date, the request's evidence is insufficient, no extension is granted and the first extension days are zero.

**Other terms.** The borrower of record is the customer the case is held for. The case's as-is appraised value is the appraised value recorded on the case.

## Worked examples (hypothetical; an invented plan limit of 120 days is used for illustration)

| Current deadline | Supporting document date | 180 days after the document | Measured extension | First extension days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 15 January | 14 July | 135 | 120 (limited) |
| 1 March | 8 September of the year before | 7 March | 6 | 30 (raised) |
| 1 March | no request awaiting a decision | none | none | 0 |
